description: Curated EXPLAIN_DEBUG evaluation scenarios for docs/DEBUG_DEPTH_CHARTER.md (D1). Human review or a dedicated harness; not merged into motadata_behavior_verify.py until charter D6/D7 unless explicitly extended.

tiers.easy: Single-file context, explicit selection; stable structured fields; selected file must appear in evidence first when present in bundle.
tiers.medium: Multi-item bundle and/or long selection; logic_flow and likely_bug_risk should cite bundle-visible identifiers; no evidence from outside bundle.
tiers.hard: Thin or ambiguous selection, or pressure toward generic advice; must remain honest (insufficient grounding, explicit limits) rather than confident fiction.

scenarios.description: Straightforward method body in one file; selection is the full method.
scenarios.query: What does this code do and what could go wrong?

scenarios.description: Minimal one-line selection; still must ground to selected file.
Two files in bundle; selection is in file A; output must not treat file B as primary without justification.
scenarios.query: Trace how this interacts with the rest of the shown context.
scenarios.fixture_note: Aligns with deterministic bundle shape used in runtime/tests/test_explain_debug_action6_proof.py (two unique path tokens).

scenarios.description: Long pasted selection (many lines) changes prompt layout; must still not hallucinate methods not in selection/bundle.
scenarios.query: What is the control flow here?
